Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You have to fill in Inscription pedagoghique; you receive this document online.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You could wrote to the pedagogcial coordinator but she was not very available. Sorbonne could definitely do more to help their erasmus students.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Successful.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't stress before travelling to France. You need to be at Sorbonne to figure everything out.

questions.answer: Easy. My boyfriend is french. I love the french culture and the language.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Don't panic. You will first have the possibility to fill out the learning agreement after arriving.
Remember to found the courses for the specific semester when choosing courses (semester 1 or semester 2)

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sorbonne offers a language programme called SIAL. They don't necessarily inform you about it but it is free and you registrer on their website.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Speaking french and learning a lot about french litterature at Sorbonne.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Registration at Sorbonne and all the bureaucratical things at Sorbonne. Finding accomodation.
